title: Ice and Rain Protection — Wing Anti-Ice Performance Penalties and Planning

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew performance data for operation with wing anti-ice selected, covering the take-off and climb penalties, the effect on fuel planning and the conditions in which the system must be on.

sections.purpose: This entry gives the flight crew the performance penalties that apply when wing anti-ice is selected and the planning consequences for take-off, climb and cruise.
sections.description: Wing anti-ice takes hot air from the engines and that air is not available for thrust, so selecting it costs performance in every phase. The take-off penalty is applied to the take-off weight through the performance application and is significant at high aerodrome elevation and high temperature, which is the combination crews least expect because those are not conditions in which icing is anticipated on the ground. In the climb the penalty appears as a reduced rate and a higher fuel flow, and in cruise as a fuel burn increase that must be carried in the flight plan if icing conditions are forecast for a significant part of the route. The system must be selected on in the conditions defined in the procedures section, and the crew does not have discretion to leave it off to recover performance.
sections.crew_procedure: Apply the wing anti-ice penalty in the take-off performance calculation whenever the system may be required for the departure, not only when icing is present at the time of calculation. Carry the additional fuel for the forecast icing segment in the flight plan. Select the system on in the defined conditions regardless of the performance cost, and report any occasion on which the required selection was not compatible with the planned performance.
sections.limitation_note: Take-off with wing anti-ice selected is subject to the weight penalty given in the performance data for the aerodrome elevation and temperature. Dispatch into forecast icing conditions requires the additional fuel for the icing segment to be carried. The system may not be left off to recover performance in conditions where the procedures require it to be on.

type_data.crew_action: Apply the anti-ice penalty in the take-off calculation and carry the additional fuel for the forecast icing segment.
